scope: Updated hypotheses, not speedup claims or completed N-series experiments. Savings are conservative guesses, not profiler-time subtraction. Preserve best N13; isolate source and verify baseline before each candidate.

experiments.title: Batch fragment creation and shape ownership publication
experiments.evidence: Warm heavy peak82 exposes allocateNativeBodies and migrateShapes. High-rate profiling reports34.88/20.89ms thread CPU; lower-rate migration is13.888ms and includes per-shape instrumentation. Wall-only migration subscopes expose contact retirement1.660ms, registration1.377ms, actor links0.735ms and refilter0.565ms. These overlapping instrumented observations are not removable application time.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Batch native body reservations and changed ShapeSim ownership/refilter/contact-retirement operations at the existing fracture-to-correction boundary. Shapes and geometry already persist; preserve that invariant. Remove redundant per-shape traversal and repeated pool/registry work while keeping current correction contacts and final ordinary actor/query publication.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Hypothesis: 5–20ms fracture peak; 1–5ms heavy mean. Zero expected idle benefit.
experiments.confidence: Medium diagnosis, low savings estimate until phase-only attribution.
experiments.experiment_cost: CPU allocator/shape lifecycle and GPU ownership publication changes; memory, query, motion, correction and full-suite gates.
experiments.supporting_measurements: Fewer lifecycle calls/allocations and lower unprofiled first-fracture full ticks with identical ownership, contacts, mass/COM, correction and accepted physical observations.
experiments.refuting_measurements: Mandatory PhysX registration dominates unchanged; savings disappear outside the profiler, or any query/contact/sleep/physical mismatch.
experiments.prior_work: N20 capacity patch is a smaller preserved experiment; rerun its memory qualification on the corrected baseline before reusing it.
experiments.source_audit: NpDestructionBodyAllocator::applyBindings already uses persistent ShapeSim IDs and defers actor/query observation in ordinary mode. ScShapeSimBase::rebindRigidOwner still refilters each migrated shape, retires contacts via onVolumeRemoved, rebinds narrowphase ownership and updates actor/SQ links. Audit batching of these actual operations; do not propose recreating or removing a full-geometry upload already absent.

prepared_follow_up.mechanism: Reserve lifetime capacity to existing node capacity before original resize/increment. No size, initialization, generation, lifetime, body, contact or phase-order changes.
prepared_follow_up.baseline_scope: Corrected snapshot-compatible runtime; unaccepted N14 numerical source remains unchanged. This requalification does not promote N14 or replace retained N13 evidence.

experiments.title: Separate anchored and free component execution
experiments.evidence: Source audit: isolated no-live-bond chunks are already omitted by labelDeviceStressBonds/rootFlags and labelDeviceStressNodes, so the original empty-system hypothesis has no reachable target. Current common component kernel retains free-projection code/resources even for the overwhelmingly anchored iterative work. N10 uses108 registers,32.09% occupancy in the later selected capture. Current matching selected captures use109 registers/thread, about32% occupancy and11–14% issue activity at113,664 chunks; register pressure is a hypothesis, not a diagnosed sole cause.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Use separate GPU-owned anchored/free work queues and template the component recurrence/preparation/preconditioning so the anchored specialization omits certified zero-dimensional nullspace work and its compiler resource footprint. Current validated mode dimension selects ownership; free components retain all projection. Preserve current equations and per-component numerical order; no CPU count readback.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Potential1–5 ms heavy mean if reduced anchored register/shared footprint improves residency; charge queue preparation and extra launch. No established saving.
experiments.confidence: high semantic equivalence under current mode certificate; medium compiler/resource benefit
experiments.experiment_cost: Private GPU component queues and templated recurrence/preconditioner, kernel launch updates; original free/anchored/interleaved/cap/topology tests, sanitizers, full A/B and counters
experiments.supporting_measurements: Both queue ownership and original physical gates pass, anchored resources fall, complete-step heavy mean/peaks improve without idle regression; independent queues enable later size decomposition
experiments.refuting_measurements: Queue divergence or invalid certificate, resource footprint unchanged, extra launch/cache costs erase benefit, full-suite regression
experiments.prior_work: N15 in the preserved main queue; source audit/preparation is not a completed experiment.

experiments.title: Size-specialized warp/block component execution
experiments.evidence: Thousands of small fragments occupy whole CTAs and block-wide reductions; earlier four-lane row gathering regressed. Current same-runtime selected stress captures use109 registers/thread, about32% occupancy and11–14% issue activity at the largest scale. Later-debris local-memory sectors increase sharply. These counters motivate investigating decomposition/resource lifetime; they do not prove spills or predict saved application time.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Use a dedicated small-component warp/block implementation, preserving row order and convergence; retain larger block path for larger components.
experiments.experiment_cost: coherent solver/reduction specialization and size dispatch, sanitizer tests
experiments.supporting_measurements: Better useful-lane occupancy and lower complete steps without sort/peak regressions
experiments.refuting_measurements: More loops/registers or dispatch overhead offsets small-component savings

experiments.title: Cached direct solves for tiny supported or projected free components
experiments.evidence: Existing N04 targets repeated small operators after fracture. Current lower-rate step179 has2,270 stress islands,87,303 active nodes and144,627 active bonds, with61.296ms aggregate stress time. Size/conditioning-weighted time share still requires a census.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Factor eligible small supported or explicitly projected free operators once per matching topology/material generation and apply the factor to each current load. Keep direct-tree elimination as a separate experiment. Preserve exact nullspace treatment, authoritative residual, damage and correction order.
affected_scenarios: mixed-size debris; dense panels/loops are controls
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Existing N04 hypothesis:3–15ms on later heavy steps, with factor setup and cache storage charged. No measured eligible-component time share yet.
experiments.confidence: High algorithmic motivation, low application share estimate.
experiments.experiment_cost: Bounded GPU component census, one direct-solve backend, independent force/moment/energy and singular/free-mode oracles.
experiments.supporting_measurements: Lower time to the same equilibrium for eligible components and complete-step benefit across the fixed suite.
experiments.refuting_measurements: Factorization/setup outweighs iterations; nullspace/conditioning failure; dense or mixed-case regression.
experiments.prior_work: N04; the historical N03 tree census must not be used to inflate dense-factor coverage.

experiments.title: Compact accepted CPU mirror updates at the producer
experiments.evidence: Current lower-rate continuous trace: idle steps81/82/179 have only~2KB H2D/~1KB D2H and0.004–0.005ms total copy union. Pre-impact active-projectile step81 reads7.741MB D2H; first fracture reads24.516MB; later step179 reads35.386MB. Copy unions1.106/4.321/6.674ms overlap kernels by0/0.013/0.081ms, but also overlap CPU work. These are diagnostic exposure, not removable full-step cost. Historical N19 failed memory qualification before the later asynchronous fix.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Build an explicit dirty set of current accepted bounds/transforms on GPU, transfer one compact contiguous batch, and update the ordinary CPU query mirror at its required boundary. Avoid redundant full-array transfer and repeated receipt waits. Preserve the trial CPU mirrors needed by afterIntegration for activity/sleep and newly sleeping-body rollback. A final-only mirror requires separately redesigning and qualifying that dependency; deferred actor/query observation is already implemented.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Hypothesis: effectively zero on fully idle warm scenes with negligible transfers; 0.3–0.9ms on active-projectile pre-impact ticks and0.5–2ms heavy mean, after packing/scatter/overlap costs.
experiments.confidence: Medium exposure, low net saving until measured.
experiments.experiment_cost: Producer dirty-set and compact receipt implementation; normal asynchronous memory, query/sleep and trajectory checks.
experiments.supporting_measurements: Lower bytes and critical-path transfer/wait time, exact current accepted query/body state and lower full steps.
experiments.refuting_measurements: Packing/scatter or synchronization costs offset DMA savings; stale mirrors or missing correction participants.
experiments.prior_work: N18 metadata combination was neutral; N19 direct mapped scatter was not memory-qualified. These are evidence, not accepted implementations.

experiments.title: Skip equilibrium work only for exactly unchanged current inputs
experiments.evidence: Lower-rate continuous heavy trace: stress kernels take41.386ms aggregate at first-fracture step82 and61.296ms at later step179. Fully idle step81 has0.059ms material evaluation,0.044ms prepareLoads and0.030ms resetNativeStressSolution. Identify verified unchanged current inputs before skipping anything; constant load can still accumulate material damage, so unchanged force alone is insufficient.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Verify the recovered stored output against the authoritative current equations and publish its exact-input certificate immediately. Reuse only when current connectivity, material/health and projected loads match. Retain material/damage evaluation and solve every changed component in this tick, including after correction.
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Existing N09 hypothesis:0–4ms in unchanged-load phases. The unchanged-input fraction is unmeasured; retain material/damage evaluation and expect zero benefit where inputs keep changing.
experiments.confidence: Medium potential; unchanged-input fraction not yet measured.
experiments.experiment_cost: GPU input/certificate audit then one cache-publication change, independent equilibrium/energy and stale-input negative tests.
experiments.supporting_measurements: Substantial verified unchanged-input fraction, eliminated launches/iterations, unchanged residual/forces/damage and lower complete steps.
experiments.refuting_measurements: Most inputs differ; certificate overhead exceeds skipped work; any stale-data acceptance.
experiments.prior_work: N09: an exact-input cache already exists, but currently needs a zero-update warm solve to certify rounded outputs. Requalify immediate post-recovery verification/publication; do not present this as inventing an absent cache.

experiments.title: Share canonical operator factors across repeated structures
experiments.evidence: The city suite instantiates25/64/256 copies of the building layout. Current heavy stress costs41.386ms at first fracture and61.296ms at later step179 under lower-rate Systems. Equality of their actual supported/damaged operators has NOT been measured; repeated geometry alone is insufficient.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: First census canonical topology/material/health/support and operator-equivalence classes. If many match, share an immutable symbolic/numerical factor or response basis, applying each instance current-tick load independently. Keep per-instance damage, changed topology and nullspace handling exact. Factor reuse within existing components already exists; this targets reuse between equivalent instances and a direct-solve route. prepareLoads already transforms gravity, angular velocity and contact impulses into the current cluster frame, so do not propose a redundant CPU transform or upload.
affected_scenarios: repeated intact city structures at first impact
repeated supported structures with different current loads
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Exploratory hypothesis: 5–20ms on heavily repeated loaded structures; possibly zero after fracture creates mostly unique operators. No measured application share of reusable factors yet.
experiments.confidence: Low until exact operator-equivalence census and sparse-factor fill/cost are measured.
experiments.experiment_cost: Start with a bounded read-only component/operator census. A subsequent shared factor/direct response prototype requires independent equilibrium/energy oracles, singular-mode and current-tick correction checks, full scenario and continuous acceptance.
experiments.supporting_measurements: Many physically equivalent operators with different current RHS; factor application plus all cache/bookkeeping costs beat existing time to the required equilibrium and lower full steps.
experiments.refuting_measurements: Operator diversity or factor fill dominates; cheap kernel time saved is offset by setup/application; any damage/support/nullspace or physical mismatch.

experiments.title: Direct equilibrium on certified free trees
experiments.evidence: Historical N03 census: no free trees before first fracture; correction has256 nontrivial trees/768 nodes, and later1,276 trees/3,853 nodes, max10 nodes. Singletons are already excluded. New long-chain/structural cases broaden coverage but do not establish a large city benefit.
experiments.proposed_mechanism: Solve certified free-tree components from projected subtree force/moment balances, then verify the recovered bond response with the unchanged residual. Do not combine this with the separate tiny dense-factor experiment.
affected_scenarios: mixed-size debris; dense panels/loops are controls
experiments.estimated_application_ms_saved: Likely below1ms heavy mean under the historical census; no first-trial benefit. A larger claim requires a current per-component time census.
experiments.confidence: Medium algebra, low city application share.
experiments.experiment_cost: Bounded GPU component census, one direct-solve backend, independent force/moment/energy and singular/free-mode oracles.
experiments.supporting_measurements: Lower time to the same equilibrium for eligible components and complete-step benefit across the fixed suite.
experiments.refuting_measurements: Factorization/setup outweighs iterations; nullspace/conditioning failure; dense or mixed-case regression.
experiments.prior_work: N03 historical coverage lowers this target priority; retain chain/tower semantic controls.
